name: PlantCLEF 2022: Large-Scale Global Plant Species Identification Benchmark
description: PlantCLEF 2022 is a large-scale visual benchmark for continental- and global-scale automated plant species identification, organized under the LifeCLEF evaluation campaign at the CLEF conference by Inria, CIRAD, and partners. Spanning approximately 80,000 vascular plant species worldwide, the benchmark provides roughly 4 million images (2.9 million trusted, curated records from GBIF, iNaturalist, and Pl@ntNet alongside 1.1 million web images), addressing the challenge of identifying rare and wild flora under real-world visual noise and long-tailed class distributions.
